mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 85 degrees at Harriet Park, although it feels like 93 degrees with the current humidity.

The City of Verona has officially installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park. This artwork, created by Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, was carved from a reclaimed ash tree and highlights the community's commitment to public art.

There is plenty to do in Verona. The Downtown Farmer's Market is taking place today at Hometown Junction Park. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. tomorrow, and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard this Thursday.
On August 30, officers responded to a collision on East Verona Avenue involving a 77-year-old driver and a 15-year-old bicyclist. Thankfully, the bicyclist was not injured in the incident.
Today's flavor is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. Culver's is currently open and will be serving this treat until 10:00 PM tonight.
